name: Commanding Presence
body:
School transmutation [evil, lawful]; Level ranger 4

CASTING

Casting Time 1 full round
Components V, S, M (a Medium larger sacrificial animal)

EFFECT

Range personal
Target you
Duration 1 hour/level (0)

DESCRIPTION

Casters of commanding presence gain an enhancement bonus of 1d4+3 to Charisma. Additionally, if the caster chooses to dismiss the spell before its duration expires, she may cast fear as a spell-like ability the following round.
